name: Builders, Backers & Big Ideas - #AZTechWeek
description:
Capital Gravity Arizona and AI Trailblazers are getting everyone together to celebrate the kickoff of Arizona Tech Week in Tucson!

Whether you're a founder or funder, a local or out-of-towner, on the bleeding edge of AI or just getting curious... let's kick off Arizona Tech Week together!

This event is part of #AZTechWeek, a week of events hosted by VCs and startups to bring together the tech ecosystem. More info at https://www.arizonatechweek.com

name: 🔍 AI Trailblazers Happy Hour—Real or AI? Be the Detective!
description:
**Can you spot the difference between a real photo and an AI-generated image?** What about after the first Margarita? Lol
Let's find out! 🕵️
**Join us for an evening of drinks,** **laughs, and friendly competition** as we put your detective skills to the test. We'll show you images, some real, some AI-created and YOU decide which is which. -**Most correct answers wins a prize!** 🎁

### **\- What We'll Explore** 🎨

🔎 **The Detective Game** — Real or AI? Test your eye and compete for bragging rights (and a gift card!)
💡 **Why It Matters** — Discuss deepfakes, misinformation, creative integrity, and why knowing the difference protects us all
🎨 **Best Tools for the Job** — Learn which AI image models create what: DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and more
🗣️ **Real Talk** — Share your experiences, concerns, and **"wait, THAT was AI?!**" moments

Bring your curiosity, your questions, your phone and show us the weird AI experiments you've tried and let's have a conversation. AI skeptics, newbies, someone who's been playing with image generators for months or Not — **you belong here!**

**Because understanding AI isn't just about using it, it's about protecting truth, creativity, and trust in our digital world**.

See you there, AI Trailblazer Detectives! 🌵✨

-We take photos at our events to share our mission of democratizing AI. If you prefer not to be photographed, let us know when you arrive.

name: AI Dev Bootcamp
description:
A hands-on, 4-week workshop series for software developers ready to build with AI coding tools.

Led by Nick Yeager, a senior software engineer who has been deep in the trenches with Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic development workflows, this series takes you from setup to shipping real projects with AI as your co-developer.

**WHAT YOU'LL BUILD**
You will work on a real open source project for AI Trailblazers, building a hackathon execution system complete with a website, idea voting, and marketing agents. Every session builds on the last, and your code gets committed back to the repo.

**SESSION SCHEDULE** (Saturdays, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM)
**Session 1: April 18** \- Foundations and Setup
Claude Code features. Skills, markdown configs, and the Plan-Revise-Test-Execute loop that makes AI coding actually productive.

**Session 2: April 25** \- Building and Iterating with Skills
Write your first skills. Learn how to make AI tools that improve over time. Start building the project.

**Session 3: May 2** \- Sub\-Agents and Parallel Work
Run multiple agents simultaneously with agent teams and worktrees. Break complex tasks into sub-agent workflows.

**Session 4: May 9 -** Evals, Hooks, and Production Patterns
Test your skills empirically. Set up evaluation loops. Hooks, automation, and patterns for real-world use.

This series leads directly into [AI Trailblazers Hackathon 3 on May 23-24](https://www.meetup.com/old-pueblo-new-economy-artificial-intelligence-trailblazers/events/313338598/?eventOrigin=group_events_list). Everything you learn here prepares you to hit the ground running at the hackathon.

**WHO THIS IS FOR**
Software developers with coding experience who want to level up with AI tools. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be comfortable writing code.

**WHAT'S INCLUDED**
Each participant gets a Claude Code Max subscription for the duration of the series. Scholarships available for those who need financial assistance.

**ABOUT THE INSTRUCTOR**
Nick Yeager is a software engineer at ScriptSave who has been building AI development tools and evangelizing agentic workflows across his organization. He has given company-wide talks on AI coding practices and built evaluation frameworks for testing AI-generated code.

Presented by AI Trailblazers in partnership with Startup Zones, Tech Catalyst, and Vantage West.

name: 🔒 Cybersecurity in the AI Revolution: Protect Yourself, Empower Your Community
description:
### **Learn from the FBI How to Stay Safe in the Digital Age**

Scams are getting smarter. AI-powered phishing is on the rise. Deep-fakes, fake emails, suspicious links, it's getting harder to tell what's real. ***But you don't have to navigate this alone.***
Join[ ](https://aitrailblazers.org/)**[\[AI Trailblazers\]](https://aitrailblazers.org/)** for a critical community conversation about **cybersecurity in the AI era**—featuring insights from FBI experts on how they're processing cybercrime cases, what threats are emerging, and most importantly, **how YOU can protect yourself and your loved ones.**

***

### **What You'll Learn** 🛡️

🔍 **Recognizing Scams & Phishing Attempts**
Fake calls, malicious links—learn the red flags that even sophisticated scams can't hide.
🚨 **Real Cases, Real Insights**
FBI is tackling cybercrime, what tactics criminals are using.
💡 **Where to Get Support**
Learn how to report incidents to[ ](https://www.ic3.gov/)**[IC3.gov](https://www.ic3.gov/)** (FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center) and what resources are available.

AI is a powerful tool for good—but it's also being weaponized by bad actors. **Knowledge is your best defense.**
This isn't about fear. It's about **awareness, empowerment, and community protection.**

**AI literacy, awareness, and technology for good—and for all.** ✨
**— AI Trailblazers**

(If you find our meetups of interest and would like to support our mission please donate to us! We are a 501c3 organization)
